meta.name: audit-integrity
meta.description: Shared audit integrity framework for all AppSec agents — enforces output quality, intellectual honesty, and continuous improvement through anti-rationalization guards, self-critique loops, retry protocols, non-negotiable behaviors, self-reflection quality gates (1-10 scoring, ≥8 threshold), and a self-learning system with lesson/memory governance for security analysis agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保障安全分析智能体的输出质量与诚实性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在构建或管理安全分析智能体，需要确保其输出可靠且持续改进。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure output quality and honesty of security analysis agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build or manage security analysis agents and need reliable, continuously improving outputs.

howto.what: 所有应用安全分析代理在输出结果前，会自动执行一系列质量检查：澄清范围、防止自我合理、强制二次自我批评、处理工具失败、遵守硬规则、自我评分（至少8分），并记录教训用于持续改进。
howto.when: 每次安全分析、代码审查、威胁建模或质量扫描完成后自动触发，作为后分析质量门。

say.text: 帮我审查这段代码的SQL注入风险。
say.note: 触发SAST分析及后续质量门。

say.text: 对这个系统做威胁建模。
say.note: 触发威胁建模及自我反思评分。

say.text: 检查刚才的分析有没有自我合理化问题。
say.note: 要求运行反合理化防护。

howto.what_en: All AppSec agents automatically run post-analysis quality checks: scope clarification, anti-rationalization, mandatory self-critique, tool failure handling, hard rules, self-scoring (≥8), and lesson logging for continuous improvement.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically after every security analysis, code review, threat model, or quality scan as a post-analysis quality gate.

say_en.text: Review this code for SQL injection risks.
Check if any rationalization occurred in the last analysis.
